title: How I AI: OpenClaw for executives: Automate every 1% annoyance
author: Lenny Rachitsky
description: Your weekly listens from How I AI, part of the Lenny’s Podcast Network
summary: In this episode, he shows how his Jarvis handles work approvals, orders lunch, calls coworkers who miss Slack messages, books restaurants, and controls his smart home. He also explains how he uses soul files, specialist subagents, and strict guardrails to make the system trustworthy, and why he is testing local models against a $500 to $600 monthly Anthropic bill.

Ankit’s first automation was a cron job that runs every four hours and briefs him on every resume awaiting approval, including candidate pedigree and GitHub history.
Teach agents the messy details, then let them keep learning.
